in_hindi.name: तेज्प्रताप्
in_hindi.long_meaning: तेजस् (tejas) - राधिक, प्रकाश, तेज (tej) - शक्ति, शक्तिवान, प्रकाशित (pratap) - प्रकाशित हुआ, अपनी शक्ति दिखानेवाला

in_tamil.name: தேஜ்ப்ரதாப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேஜ் (tej) - அவ்விடம் விழுவாத, அவ்விடம் இல்லாத அவ்வைத் தேஜம் + ப்ரதாப் (pratap) - அவ்விடம் பிடித்து அவ்வைத் தேஜம் அழைப்பான

in_telugu.name: తెజ్ప్రతాప్
in_telugu.long_meaning: తెజోశ్ (tejosh) - ఆశేషద్యోజనే, ఆశేషద్యోజనేయే ప్రజాపతి + ప్రధూణేయోజనే ప్రభావము + ప్రథాప్ (pratap) - ప్రధూణేయోజనే ప్రభావము దిఖాయోజనే

in_marathi.name: Tejpratap
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power and Might
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tejpratap हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tejpratap means the one who carries the god of power and strength Tej on his head. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'tejas' which means radiant and 'pratap' which means powerful, strong and unconquerable.

in_bengali.name: Tejpratap
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Power and Might
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tejpratap একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Tejpratap means the one who carries the god of power and strength Tej on his head. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'tejas' which means radiant and 'pratap' which means powerful, strong and unconquerable.
